title: PRIOR: belief, evidence, bounded intent

scenes.claim: PRIOR connects belief, intent, execution, and evidence continuity.
Accepted Shannon evidence shows attributable Forecast and bounded consequence.
The live surface discovers a bounded market and gates Forecast signing.
A Circuit preserves bounded intent across market iterations.
History is account-aware and requires a connected wallet before account-specific evidence.
Profile is account-aware and does not fabricate disconnected identity evidence.

limitations: No wallet transaction is recorded in this demo.
No autonomous economic execution is claimed.
The live surface uses bounded market discovery and the selected hero Circuit is complete.
